text: Bad news: Mill Co raises flour by 8% from October 1. A 25 kg bag goes from ¥6,300 to ¥6,800. We use about 28 bags a month.
The flour price increase takes effect October 1. A 25 kg bag goes from ¥6,300 to ¥6,800, and with about 28 bags used each month, that's an increase of ¥14,000 per month starting in October.
300 croissants. I can't stop thinking about the flour.

300 croissants on a strong Saturday — that's the kind of day that makes the numbers matter. The flour increase of ¥500 per bag will add ¥14,000 to your monthly cost from October. That's a noticeable shift, but your weekend sales show the demand is there.
